items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Caravan, which was like I said before, was arranged by Neal Hefti.

ctx.x: Betty Grable, and they used to play -- we used to feature it in Caravan, which was like I said before, was arranged by Neal Hefti. And I had a little thing at the end, and at the end, the drummer kept on going, and nobody told me to do it -- I just did it for the first time, you know? So he told me to go out on the front of the stage, and I started dancing, doing a few steps and I did that movement that some people laugh at. But they kept it in.
So you kept doing it in the show?
